text.en: Atlas original Heat design study (docs/55). Generic bench 1.8 × 0.7 m, top 0.75 m. DESIGN: water 200/300/400 g, c=4.2 J/(g·K), power 0/50/100 W, time 0–300 s; cooler starts 5/45/65/85 °C in a fixed 25 °C environment, conductance bare 2 or wrapped 0.5 W/K; spoon tips start 25 °C, each effective capacity 20 J/K, maintained bath 5/25/45/65/85 °C, effective conductances 1/3 and 1/30 W/K. Rod: 0.1 m at 25 °C, alpha 0.000012/K; separate displacement indicator ×500. SIM: at120 s heater39.285714286 °C, energy12000 J; at300 s cooler bare54.372499573 °C, wrapped75.187858438 °C; at60 s hot-bath tips62.927233530 and30.709754918 °C; at85 °C rod delta0.072 mm, indicated0.036 m.

note.en: Not measurements. C=mc; C dT/dt=P−U(T−Ta); T=T0+Pt/C for U=0, otherwise T=Ta+P/U+(T0−Ta−P/U)exp(−Ut/C). E=C(T−T0), supplied=Pt, reservoir energy=Pt−E. DeltaL=L0 alpha(T−Tref). Background equations S4/S6/S29; representative steel coefficient S5. Ignores cup capacity, spatial gradients, evaporation and variable surroundings. Baths externally maintained; equal effective tip capacities are teaching parameters. Liquid levels and gas/liquid/ball poses qualitative; fixed rod geometry, separate enlarged indicator. Original geometry/art; no third-party assets or downloaded observations.
note.zh: 并非实测。热容量C=mc；C dT/dt=P−U(T−Ta)；U为零时温度按恒功率直线上升，否则按指数趋近。净传入能量=C×温差，外部供能=Pt，热库所得=供能−净传入。伸长量=原长×系数×温差。公式依据S04/S6/S29、钢代表值S05。忽略杯热容、空间温度梯度、蒸发和变动环境；温浴外部维持，勺端相同有效热容是教学参数。液位及气体/液体/球姿态仅定性；钢杆几何不变，只移动独立放大指示。几何与插画原创，无第三方资产及下载观测。
